Getting the blood test, however, was a complete farce ( but that's for another review for blood test team). I was sent from pillar to post for an urgent blood test but the practice team were amazing, helping me to get the blood test asap. The HCA Erin was amazing. In the end she tried to do blood test herself but struggled(not her fault, it's my veins) and when she couldn't do it she came with me to the blood test place and basically shamed them into conducting my blood test. I'm very grateful to her.
Luckily I haven't got what was suspected but I'm grateful to Dr. Ahmed for being Thank you for your feedback. We have been able to speak to the members of staff involved in your recent conversations to clarify your issues. Unfortunately we cannot respond completely here as it would breach your parents confidentiality. If you would like to speak to us further, please contact our practice manager. 
As a general point though, whilst we appreciate it can be hard as patients get older, it is not always safe or possible to arrange medical services on a domiciliary basis. It also means fewer patients are seen in a working day leading to longer waiting lists. The NHS is working hard to use technology such as phone and video consultations to make people's lives easier, but it is not always possible to safely assess patients this way in their own homes.
